home.title: Welcome to DevLeo
home.description: DevLeo is a personal initiative dedicated to sharing projects, ideas, and research in a clear, expressive, and didactic way. While its structure resembles that of a digital magazine, its purpose goes beyond simple publication, serving as a space for continuous documentation, reflection, and experimentation. The platform brings together software development projects, technical studies, and research-oriented work, presenting not only final results but also the processes, challenges, and decisions involved in each initiative. By combining practical development with analytical and investigative approaches, DevLeo seeks to bridge the gap between implementation and understanding. Through articles, project showcases, and technical notes, the site aims to promote knowledge sharing, encourage critical thinking, and provide a transparent view of ongoing learning and exploration across different areas of technology and science.

about.title: About Leo
about.description: Hello, I'm Leo. I am a university student in Physics and Computer Science, with a strong interest in both theoretical foundations and practical applications. For the past two years, I have been working as an instructor, teaching robotics and programming, while also developing software solutions for small and medium-sized businesses. I am deeply passionate about learning and continuous improvement. Currently, I am studying Mandarin with the goal of obtaining the HSK (Hanyu Shuiping Kaoshi) certification, further expanding my academic and cultural horizons.
